title: Little Lemon restaurant API
tagline: A Django REST Framework API for a restaurant: public menu, customer carts, orders and role-based access for managers and delivery crew.
problem: A restaurant needs one API for its public menu, customer carts and orders, where managers and delivery crew can each do only their part.
built: Token authentication with Djoser, three roles driven by Django groups, server-side cart pricing that turns into an order in one request, an order lifecycle for managers and delivery crew, and filtering, search, ordering, pagination and per-user throttling. Built for the Meta back-end track and taken further.
highlights: 58 automated tests covering every endpoint and role
Data migration guarantees the role groups always exist; one command seeds demo users and menu
GitHub Actions CI, MIT licence, uv-based setup
testing: 58 automated tests cover every endpoint and role, run on GitHub Actions on every push.
